name: @anywalletkit/protocol-swap2-kyberswap
description: KyberSwap Aggregator same-chain swaps: keyless public API (or the gateway with a key), settled through MetaAggregationRouterV2 only; the build's calldata decoded strictly and re-encoded byte for byte, router, executor, tokens, amounts, receiver, minimum, fee receivers and flags checked against the request, simulated before signing. No integrator fee.
